spine.deviation_notes: The corpse-summon -> transient-proxies-execute-your-linked-strike identity lands via PROXY_FISSION + on-cast-linked/linked-cast trigger-grammar at depth-1, but two properties generalize: (a) the mirages perform an EXERTED (warcry-boosted) copy of the player's SPECIFIC linked skill -- the engine models a generic linked-cast, not a faithful clone of an arbitrary chosen strike; (b) the corpse-consumption gate (no corpses = no warriors) is a resource dependency the economy lane approximates rather than a hard summon-fuel primitive. skills.delivery_notes: a warcry (3s cooldown) that consumes nearby CORPSES to summon Mirage Warriors (2 corpses per 5 Power, up to ~5-6); the cry itself is a self-origin proc-trigger, not damage. self_buff = the warcry activation handle; the summoned warriors carry the offense

each Mirage Warrior spawns at a corpse position and immediately performs ONE exerted cast of the player's LINKED strike skill (e.g. Blade Flurry/Cyclone/Boneshatter), then vanishes. Transient melee proxy executing a linked-cast. melee_arc = the wide frontal strike the linked skill typically delivers; physical melee -> element-neutral (flavor); bleed is the common linked-skill ailment rider

mapping_json.motion_frame: corpse-fuelled burst summoner: press the warcry, a squad of mirage warriors erupts from nearby corpses and all simultaneously slam the pack with YOUR linked attack, then disappear -- repeat on cooldown

economy: Power accumulation from nearby enemies/corpses -> more warriors

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: TRIGGER+PROXY hybrid: warcry -> summon transient proxies that each fire a LINKED-CAST of the player's strike. trigger_grammar carries proc_trigger_condition=on-cast-linked + consequence_type=linked-cast (the mirages execute the linked skill); trigger_chain_shape=apply-only at DEPTH-1 (warcry triggers the mirage-cast; the mirage's own hit is the terminal step, NOT a further nested trigger -- respects MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1). PROXY_FISSION is the exact door: ONE action (the cry) -> MANY transient proxies. Physical melee (mirages) -> element-neutral (flavor); bleed as the typical linked-skill ailment (Blade Flurry variant). ERRATA NOTE: era floor corrected to 3.11 at ingest (skill added patch 3.11); verify_ledger authoritative. charge_stack_sub_shape=cycle models the Power->warrior-count accumulate/spend rhythm. The corpse-consumption gate (needs corpses to summon) is a resource dependency noted in the economy lane; the 'mirages copy YOUR exact linked skill' is captured by linked-cast though the engine abstracts WHICH skill to a generic linked strike.
